documents.title: Bradley County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 41 pages. Amounts are the 'Amount Requested Next Year' — the only amount column; Ordinance 2025-12 Section 1 adopts this budget as filed column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
